hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The power of a subsequence of length L with sum k is 2^(n - L).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Each number can either be excluded from the subset (factor 2 across present/absent in superset) or included into the subset (adds x to sum).

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For each number x in nums, update dp[s] = (dp[s] * 2 + dp[s - x]) modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 1D dynamic programming with transition dp[s] = 2*dp[s] + dp[s - x].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n subsequences takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model the 2^(n - L) factor algebraically through DP state duplication.
